digest.component_or_area: Gerrit Verified CI on GitHub Actions
propositions: macOS default tier pytest execution time increased from ~677s (Aug 1, run 30723712651) to ~1,453s (current, run 31631448140), representing +14m31s growth driven by ~4.1k additional selected tests and ~91k test lines added across repo history.

Five unit tests execute expensive real-world mechanics (120s Jira field timeout, captured 5s sleeps on import, production 5xx backoff, 15s real sockets/timeouts, repeated AST parsing) that are not representative of production usage and account for material portions of the slow-tail growth.

Wiki corpus lru_cache populated once per xdist worker instead of once per session, causing redundant recomputation and 321–495 aggregate seconds wasted on corpus tests in macOS jobs; this defect landed post-mutation and did not contribute to the original regression measurement.

Mutation testing added at e0b3fdfc8e did not extend the critical path (0m observed addition across 62 post-mutation runs) and was skipped in 57/62 runs, so it cannot be the direct cause of the 15–20m to 30–40m regression present across all runs.

Org-level macOS runner contention (GitHub Free tier: 5 macOS jobs max) amplifies deterministic work and queue latency (median 0.72m, p90 13.53m) but is not the root cause of the pytest execution growth; the 14m31s growth is from test code expansion and expensive test mechanics.
Seven decomposed remediation tickets target coverage-neutral fixes to slow tests, cached recomputation, and injected delays, without changing worker count, parallelism, or aggregate runner usage.
